findings.description: The `finally` clause sets `job.next_run = now + job.interval` after both the success and failure paths. On failure it overwrites the `now + self._retry_delay(job)` set at line 65, so the backoff is computed and then discarded. Failed jobs are retried only after the full interval, and `retry_delay` has no effect.
findings.suggestion: Set `job.next_run = now + job.interval` only in the `else` branch (success), or remove the `finally` block and keep the failure-path assignment.
